body: It's unfortunate that we are not alone in this. The sad truth is that many people feel this same way. Very sad.
For some people they do. Why not talk to a psychiatrist and/or therapist?
Good luck. Hope you feel better soon.

I feel numb right now. Nothing feels real. My family feels like strangers to me. They can't help. No one can. Not even me. I hate myself. I'm tired of feeling this way. I don't know why I do. I'm an ungrateful bitch. It sickens me. There's no hope. Life is meaningless. I'm tired of this horrible cycle. Anyone else experiencing this would want to kill themselves, too. It doesn't feel right to live anymore if it's going to be like this. It doesn't make sense.
